summary: Generated one Playwright validation spec for the 'Max 10 Trilogy Domains' story and extended the existing Tenant form POM in place. No ADO branch or PR was created because run_mode is dry-run.

modified_in_place.change: Added 'duplicateDomainError' locator for the uniqueness/duplicate validation message.
Added getTrilogyDomainCount, fillTrilogyDomainsUpTo, setTrilogyDomainAt, isAddDomainDisabled, assertTrilogyDomainCount, assertAddDomainDisabled, assertDuplicateDomainError.

created.change: New spec: login + tenant selection, open Create form, add up to 10 unique domains, assert count=10 and '+' disabled, assert duplicate-domain error, cancel, sign out.

how_to_run: pwsh ui/scripts/preflight-guardrails.ps1   # regenerates tests/config/test-config.ts and .env from workflow-input.current.json
self_healing_note: self_healing is enabled (report-driven). After a real run produces test-results/results.json, invoke heal-tests.agent.md to repair any locator-driven failures (locators/ files only).
to_open_pr_when_ready: Set run_mode to 'execute', provide reviewer_ado_user_id + target_repo, and set execution_confirmation to 'APPROVED_EXECUTE' in .github/ui/config/workflow-input.current.json.
Re-run the orchestrator to let create-ado-pr.agent.md create the branch, commit the tests, and open the ADO PR.
